categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing, focusing on chemical raw materials, high-end chemical drugs, and biopharmaceuticals. The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of anesthetic and analgesic drugs, cardiovascular drugs, anti-tumor drugs, endocrine drugs, and pediatric medicines. It also provides contract manufacturing and development services (CMO/CDMO) and technical services and licensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical technologies including drug molecular structure design, AI-assisted structure optimization, chiral synthesis, PROTAC technology, nasal spray formulations, and protein/enzyme screening. It has established six core technology platforms covering drug crystal form innovation, innovative drug design and synthesis, controlled-release technologies, formulation process design, nasal spray delivery, and mRNA raw material synthesis. Production adheres to GMP and international standards, with facilities certified by FDA, EMA, and other regulatory bodies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, medical institutions, pharmaceutical distributors, and international pharmaceutical companies. The company serves domestic markets extensively across China and is expanding its presence in international markets including the US, Europe, and Belt and Road countries. Its products target clinical needs in anesthesia and pain management, cardiovascular diseases, oncology, and other therapeutic areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in Southwest, East, North, South, Central, Northeast, and Northwest China regions. It has manufacturing and R&D centers in Chengdu and Shanghai. Internationally, it has expanded into the US (FDA-approved products), Europe, and countries along the Belt and Road initiative such as Poland and Kazakhstan.
categories.supply_chain_position: EastonBio operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream chemical raw material production, midstream drug formulation and manufacturing, and downstream sales and distribution. It integrates raw material supply with drug formulation, enhancing cost control and supply stability. The company also offers CMO/CDMO services, positioning itself as a comprehensive pharmaceutical manufacturer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth with over 20% of revenue invested in R&D. It focuses on differentiated product pipelines in anesthesia and pain management, cardiovascular, oncology, and biopharmaceuticals. Strategic R&D initiatives include advancing small molecule new drugs, biologics (monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies), improved formulations, and international registration of products. It emphasizes technology platform development, internationalization, and clinical value-driven drug development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of chemical drugs, raw materials, and biopharmaceuticals. Additional income comes from contract manufacturing and development services (CMO/CDMO), technical service fees, and technology licensing or transfers. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EastonBio is positioned as a leading high-tech pharmaceutical company in China with strong competitive advantages in anesthesia and pain management drugs. It holds top market shares for key products like Nalmefene, Naloxone, and Ibuprofen injections. The company is recognized for its innovation capabilities and international certifications, competing with major domestic and multinational pharmaceutical firms in high-end generics and innovative drugs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a slight decline of 4.56% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 226.57 million, down 8.09%. Total assets reached RMB 3.35 billion, growing 10.91% from the prior year. Despite short-term revenue pressure due to national procurement policies, the company maintains strong cash flow and steady growth in R&D investment and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EastonBio emphasizes patient-centered innovation, focusing on unmet clinical needs with differentiated and high-quality pharmaceutical products. Its integrated raw material and formulation capabilities ensure cost-effective, stable supply and quality control. The company’s competitive edge lies in its advanced technology platforms, strong patent portfolio, regulatory approvals including FDA, and a robust product pipeline in anesthesia, cardiovascular, and oncology therapeutics, enabling it to deliver unique clinical value and international market access.
